avatar.description: Avatar for the byline, seeded as an already-stored media item. Unlike a content `$media` reference, nothing is downloaded: the caller supplies the `storageKey` of a file that already exists in the configured storage (the common case when seeding alongside a media migration). A `media` row is created and linked via `avatarMediaId`.

id.description: Seed-local ID for byline references in content entries

alt.description: Alt text for the avatar image.

filename.description: Filename for the media record. Defaults to the storage key's basename.

mimeType.description: MIME type for the media record. Defaults to `image/jpeg`.

storageKey.description: Storage key of an avatar file that already exists in the configured storage.
